710-1703-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-1703-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-3899.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-3327-3899.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

1978-3430-4087-5793.description:
Activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Lavabrink Floodgates which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

1494-1742-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3129-4659-5346-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of it due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1409-4365-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

575-2438-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3773-5147-6972--112.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
3773-5147-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

944-2060-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

431-1308-3129-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-3129-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

518-1751-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-1751-6191.description:
Cast Storm King's Thunder by paying {1}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Storm King's Thunder triggers, opying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 7.

997-2506-2721.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

2656-4417--84.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Hex Parasite abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

2511-6243-6288.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

225-774-907.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1495-4369-4613.notablePrerequisites: The Red Terror has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4369-4613.description:
Activate The Red Terror using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

710-2292-2843.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

144-628-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 5, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

864-1170-2701.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard that has legal targets and that can be cast using {B}{B}.
864-1170-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast the other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the instant or sorcery.
Repeat.

678-5173-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Shambling Ghast's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1657-1799-2034-2048.notablePrerequisites: Murderous Redcap does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1657-1799-2034-2048.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding {C}{C}.
When Murderous Redcap dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Murderous Redcap on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Murderous Redcap into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

326-4258.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Chain of Smog, discarding two cards and choosing to copy it, targeting yourself with the copy.
Repeat from step 2.

802-1003-1846-3198.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Islands.
802-1003-1846-3198.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its Mutate cost by paying {U}{U}, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
Lore Drakkis's mutate ability triggers, causing you to return Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the mutated creature that contains the nontoken Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two Islands.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.
